verdict.rationale: Zulip documents its own export tools for moving freely between Zulip Cloud and self-hosted servers. The export covers public data, plus private messages from members who consent, and the same software can be self-hosted, which supports leaving. The evidence does not show that the export uses open, documented formats, and the export is organization-level and admin-run, with private data gated on member consent, so it is not clearly 'all of my data' for an individual user. Missing for 10: documentation of the export file format as open/standard, a user-level self-service export of all personal data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full exit/migration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Zulip has high quality export tools that can be used to migrate between the hosted Zulip Cloud service and your own servers.
You can move freely between Zulip Cloud hosting and your own servers with our high quality export and import tools.
Everything in the export of public data, plus all the private channel messages and direct messages that members who have allowed administrators to export their private data can access.
When you self-host Zulip, you get the same software as our Zulip Cloud customers.
